options.name: droplet_ids
options.description: List of droplet ids to be assigned to the firewall

options.name: inbound_rules
options.description: Firewall rules specifically targeting inbound network traffic into DigitalOcean

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the firewall rule to create or manage

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token. There are several other environment variables which can be used to provide this value. i.e., - C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN).

options.name: outbound_rules
options.description: Firewall rules specifically targeting outbound network traffic from DigitalOcean

options.name: state
options.description: Assert the state of the firewall rule. Set to 'present' to create or update and 'absent' to remove.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags to be assigned to the firewall

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds used for polling DigitalOcean's API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(no) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
